messages.subject: Using parameters from g.calibrate
parts:
Hi,

I am using the g.calibrate function to process some ACC Actigraph files and want to check if I am applying the offset/scale obtained from the autocalibration to my original input data correctly. In the calibration process, the data points are scaled with the negative of the offset obtained by the ICP-fitting process and 1/scale. (as shown below)



Does that mean I should apply the scale function with the negative of the offset in the center parameter? Or without the negative sign?


Thanks for the help!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Using parameters from g.calibrate
parts:
Yes, with negative offset value as we do here:
https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/R/g.getmeta.R#L392-L415

Vincent
